title: Book One · Chapter 80: The Word on the Card
story:
The next afternoon, Mum stops at Mr Sun's counter on the way from school.

She needs a time from Dad. When will he be home? Ronan stands beside her, behind the white line.

The returned handle is on the bench. There is a red mark on its card. Ronan does not like the red mark.

“Is that bad?” he asks.

Mr Sun looks at the card too.

“This job is back. The mark tells us that. We need to know about it.”

“Will everyone see?”

“We all see it in this shop. We need the information.”

Dad is at the back. He comes forward with a cloth in his hand. Mum asks her question. He says he needs another hour.

Ronan looks at the card again.

“It could say your name smaller,” he whispers.

Dad hears him. He sets the cloth down.

“My name belongs on my work.”

“Even that work?”

“Someone made a mistake here. We need that person's name.”

Mr Sun turns towards a customer. Mum steps aside to let the woman past. Ronan moves too, but keeps his eyes on Dad.

Dad brings the handle to the front of the bench. He points to a small mark beside the repaired part. He checked that part. Then he made this mark.

“I checked this. Mr Sun will check it too.”

“Because he does not trust you?”

Dad breathes in slowly.

“This job went wrong. We need someone else to check it with me.”

Ronan looks at the two men. Mr Sun is not smiling. Dad is not smiling either. They still make room for one another at the bench.

The customer leaves a saucepan. Its wooden handle is loose. Mr Sun writes a card. He asks her to return tomorrow afternoon. Dad reads the card after she leaves.

“We have many jobs for tomorrow,” he says. “There may not be enough time.”

Mr Sun looks at the waiting jobs. “Which one can be ready first?”

They look together. For a little while they speak about time and parts. Dad does not say yes to everything. Mr Sun does not like every answer. In the end, they move two cards. The third card stays in place.

Mum touches Ronan's shoulder. They saw enough for today. Other work is waiting at home.

On the walk back, “Do you like Mr Sun?” Ronan asks Mum.

“I do not know him very well,” she says.

“He makes Dad feel bad.”

“The wrong job makes your dad feel bad too.”

Mum does not say more. They cross a quiet side street together.

“Can both be true?” Ronan asks.

“Yes.”

At home, he takes out his own test page. There is a picture of Leo's finger above the stones. It shows the test. It does not show everything about Leo.

He puts the page beside the wider boat drawing, not under it. Both belong to their project.

He writes one more line on a fresh scrap. Leo tried to help. The finger picture still shows the mistake. Now the new line gives Leo's reason too. Ronan will ask Leo about the line tomorrow. He puts it beside the page for now. He does not paste it onto their test record. Leo must read it before they add it.

Dad comes home an hour later. Ronan does not ask about the red mark. “Did the handle work for both of you?” he asks.

“It did,” Dad says. “Tomorrow the owner will try it too.”
studyGuide:
## 重点表达

- information＝信息
- check it with me＝和我一起检查它
- enough time＝足够时间
- belong to＝属于

额外情节词（不要求本章全部记住）：saucepan＝有柄小锅；paste＝粘贴；record＝记录。

## 读句提示

**Did the handle work for both of you?**

这把手／给你们两人试时／能正常用吗？Did起直接问句。

## 理解问题

1. 返修卡片为什么要保留Dad的名字？
2. Ronan对那张红色标记卡片的理解怎样变化？
